text: At her bayside mansion, Countess Federica Donati is strangled by her husband, who stages it as a suicide and is stabbed to death moments later. Over the next day, everyone [with a claim on the bay|wants|wealth and ambition] converges on it: an architect, the countess's fisherman son, a daughter and her husband, and four friends who trespass for a swim. Bodies pile up in cottages and boats, [cut down with a billhook and a spear|images|weapons and tools], until [no one who wanted the land is left standing|ending|everyone dies].
